mechanism: Both drugs can cause hepatotoxicity and nephrotoxicity; acetaminophen may increase amikacin nephrotoxicity risk through additive renal injury, particularly with excessive acetaminophen doses or in patients with pre-existing renal impairment.
action: Monitor renal function (serum creatinine, BUN) and hepatic function regularly; use acetaminophen at lowest effective dose and avoid exceeding 3-4 g/day; ensure adequate hydration to minimize nephrotoxicity risk.
